Summary Metrics (current view):
- Total ARR in sheet: $1,028,000
- ARR with base probability > 50%: $540,000
- Estimated ARR at risk (base model): $315,600 (sum of ARR*(1 - base_prob))
- Projected 30-day churn exposure (top 3 at-risk accounts by signal): $198,000

Scenario modeling rules (short):
- Base Probability: CS qualitative estimate converted to % using Signal Score bands (Signal > 75 -> +10 pts; 50-75 -> 0; 25-50 -> -15; <25 -> -30).
- Upside Scenario: assumes positive concessions (pilot/discount + exec involvement) and shortens Time-to-Contract by 25-50% -> apply Upside Scenario Adj to base probability.
- Downside Scenario: assumes competitive win or catastrophic technical blocker -> apply Downside Scenario Adj to base probability.
- Time-to-Contract heuristic: if days remaining < 30, escalate to "immediate outreach" cadence; if < 60 and Signal < 40, schedule exec briefing.

Monte Carlo sketch (for CS team use):
- Inputs: base probability per account, upside/downside adj, distribution of concession efficacy (modeled as beta distribution centered on 0.35 for concessions), conversion lag (log-normal).
- Output: 95% CI for ARR retained at renewal date, per-account probability of requiring exec escalation, expected concession cost.
- Note: this sheet includes a simple deterministic scenario run; Monte Carlo pipeline is tracked separately in JIRA-CS-2399 (do not duplicate here).

Playbook snippets & outreach cadence (templates below):
- Low-touch (base prob > 70): Monthly check-in email + usage summary. Subject: "Quarterly performance review + renewal planning". Attach: token-level cost/latency snapshot.
- Mid-touch (40-70): Schedule 30-min renewal prep call -> deliver 1-pager ROI analysis -> propose options. Subject: "Renewal options & performance summary".
- High-touch (<40): Immediate CSM + Solutions Architect workshop -> Exec sponsor intro -> propose pilot or holdback terms. Subject: "Urgent: renewal at-risk — request for architecture review".

Scoring rubric (quick):
- Signal Score components (0-100): Usage (40%), Product Health (25%), Finance posture (15%), Exec engagement (10%), Support volume (10%).
- Translate to base probability: 0-20 => 15%; 21-40 => 30%; 41-60 => 50%; 61-80 => 70%; 81-100 => 90%. Adjust with heuristics above.

- Liam: prepare cost/latency breakdown for AtlasRetail; coordinate finance note (due 2026-03-17).

Open questions & hypotheses to validate (workspace):
- Which concession types historically moved probability most (pilot vs discount vs exec involvement)? Link to retro: JIRA-ANALYTICS-412.
- Can we automate Signal Score derivation from Console telemetry (token-level + errors) by April? Owner: Product-Analytics.

Versioning & provenance:
- Template created by Priya Nair 2025-12-10. Iterations are lightweight in this sheet; please copy-to-new for major changes.

Notes for reviewers:
- This sandbox intentionally mixes deterministic rows and playbook notes; aim to extract high-touch accounts into the dedicated "renewal-orbit" tracker once playbook consensus is reached.
- Use linked artifacts for Monte Carlo and analytics references rather than embedding heavy sims here.

End of sheet.
